closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, protein, and strong comfort-food appeal, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin A, low iron, and glycemic index. It is good for practical meals, energy and endurance sports, and digestion because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, the carb section gives usable fuel, and fibre supports digestion and steadier meals.
